8.37.2. iLock_Geography.switch_types.copyAttr¶

iLock_Geography.switch_types.copyAttr(oldEntity, newEntity)¶

Small help-function for copying over attributes from one entity to another.

Parameters:
  • oldEntity (IGraph | IPath | IEdge | INode | IRailyardObject) – The entity to copy attributes from
  • newEntity (IGraph | IPath | IEdge | INode | IRailyardObject) – The entity to copy attributes to
Return type:

none
Returns:

Adds the attributes of oldEntity to newEntity
